About Satav Automotive

Satav Automotive is your Yamaha dealership at Survey No 15, Hadapsar. Walk in to test the R-series, book a scooter, or enquire about the new EC-06 and Aerox E.

Yamaha Corporation makes musical instruments and audio equipment. Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd. builds motorcycles, marine products and power equipment.

Founding history

  • 1851Torakusu Yamaha is born on April 20. He trains in watchmaking and medical equipment repair.
  • 1887He repairs a school reed organ in Hamamatsu, then builds Japan's first domestic reed organ.
  • 1897Nippon Gakki Co., Ltd. is established. It later becomes Yamaha Corporation.
  • 1900The first upright piano is built. The tuning-fork logo is adopted.
  • 1916Torakusu Yamaha passes away, leaving a leading instrument maker.

Yamaha Motor in India

Yamaha Motor entered India in 1985 as a joint venture. In August 2001 it became a 100% subsidiary of Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd., Japan. In 2008, Mitsui & Co. Ltd. agreed with YMC to become a joint investor in India Yamaha Motor Private Limited.
